narrative_engine.thesis: trend down context (H4 stack down · D1 stack down · EMA spread -0.42 ATR · price holds below Day VWAP) set the SHORT bias. Price pulled back into the confluence zone 0.07970-0.08201 (VWAP band · POC · EMA pocket · PDH/PDL flip) — the trigger is still pending. Risk is defined beyond 0.08346; the first objective pays 1.95R at 0.08029.

plan.invalidation: structure beyond 0.08346 (signal zone / ±2σ VWAP / 0.5 ATR buffer)
